description.fun: Alomomola is the sea's nurse: when it finds a wounded Pokémon floating in the open sea, it holds it in its fins, heals it with its special membrane and carries it to shore. Its reason may be less kind than it seems, since whatever is hunting a weakened Pokémon might attack Alomomola too. Fishermen take one on long voyages instead of a doctor. Its name is a palindrome, and it's based on an ocean sunfish.
description.guide: Alomomola is a Water-type sunfish Pokémon wrapped in a special membrane that heals wounds. It helps injured Pokémon and carries them to shore. It does not evolve.
description.tagline: A heart-shaped sunfish that nurses injured Pokémon back to shore.
